import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from audit import decode_image
from bisect import bisect_right
LANES=(4,8,16)
case={'initial':[], 'transactions':[[['set','2001:db8::/32',5]]], 'bursts':[
        {'version':0,'repeat':2,'addresses':['2001:db8::1','::']},
        {'version':1,'repeat':1,'addresses':['2001:db8::1','::']}],
      'cache_pages':2,'costs':{'hit':1,'miss':9,'decode':[0,1,2]}}
req={'cases':[case]}
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),
                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
res=out['cases'][0]
allnodes=[];allstarts=[];allhops=[]
for v in res['versions']:
    nodes,size=decode_image(v['image'],[int(x,16) for x in v['starts']],v['hops'])
    allnodes.append(nodes);allstarts.append([int(x,16) for x in v['starts']]);allhops.append(v['hops'])
work=0
for burst in req['cases'][0]['bursts']:
    v,repeat=burst['version'],burst['repeat']
    nodes=allnodes[v]
    visits={};touched=set()
    for text in burst['addresses']:
        address=int(text,16)
        off=64
        while True:
            visits[off]=visits.get(off,0)+1
            touched.add(off)
            node=nodes[off]
            if node['kind']==1:
                run=node['lo']+bisect.bisect_right(node['keys'],address)-1
                break
            off=node['children'][bisect.bisect_right(node['keys'],address)]
    for off in sorted(touched):
        n=nodes[off];k=len(n['keys'])
        contrib=repeat*(n['pages']*(1 if n['cached'] else 9)+((k+LANES[n['mode']]-1)//LANES[n['mode']]+[0,1,2][n['mode']])*visits[off])
        print('burst v%d off %d kind %d mode %d cached %d pages %d keys %d visits %d contrib %d'%(v,off,n['kind'],n['mode'],n['cached'],n['pages'],k,visits[off],contrib))
        work+=contrib
print('audit-style work',work,'reported',res['objective'])
EOF
